name: nano-game-starter
description: A small 3D game that sells looks for Nano (XNO), on your own Cloudflare account. No keys on the server.
author: Pugs, LLC

scripts.dev: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --local
scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

DB.description: The database for orders, owned looks and sign-ins. Cloudflare makes it for you.

RECEIVE_ADDRESS.description: **Your own Nano address** (from Berry Wallet: Receive, then Copy). Players pay you here, and only this address can open `/admin`. Leave the example address to keep the game in test mode: every pay screen then says **TEST MODE: DO NOT PAY**.

TEST_MODE.description: `on` keeps every pay screen in test mode, even with your own address. Set `off` when you are ready to sell.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Optional. The public site key of a free [Cloudflare Turnstile](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/turnstile) widget for your game's address. Leave empty to skip it (the admin page then shows a warning).

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: Optional. The secret key of the same Turnstile widget. Leave empty to skip it.

NODE_API_KEY.description: Optional but advised. A free API key from [Nanswap Nodes](https://nanswap.com/nano-node). Payments are checked there first, then on public Nano nodes. Leave empty to use only the public nodes.
